name: Skeleton
description: A decorative loading placeholder for content that is still being fetched or prepared.

shape.description: Base silhouette. Use className only to tune dimensions/layout.

animated.description: Pulse the placeholder when the user has not requested reduced motion.

className.description: Layout and size escape hatch: width, height, flex/grid placement. Do not restyle color, radius, or animation.

aria-hidden.description: Skeleton is decorative by default. Put accessible loading copy or aria-busy on the parent.

render.description: Polymorphic render target, Base UI style. Rarely needed.

forbidden: Do not use Skeleton as the only loading announcement; parent regions need accessible loading text or aria-busy.
Do not put final content text inside Skeleton.
Do not restyle color, radius, or animation via className; use the closed props and tokens.
Do not show Skeleton for tiny optimistic waits that would resolve without a visible loading state.

responsive.note: Skeleton should match the layout it is replacing on both mobile and desktop. Let rows wrap/stack the same way as final content.
